Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887.

TICKED:
- AC1 (root cause): identified — the metric backend's presence in the reconstructed account depended on ambient PATH (an installed scc/lizard makes the tiny fixture produce no metric evidence record). Canonical ticket 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1 (closed); fix commit 81b3b5929423a641cbf9dbf806796599df01d59f pins engine_b._METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing tool at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:100.
- AC3 (right side corrected, not weakened): the TEST was the wrong side and it was strengthened, not weakened — the assertions at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:112-115 now require metric present AND skipped>=1 AND reason no_tool>=1. Production grounding source unchanged. Verified: pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q -> 5 passed.

LEFT UNTICKED — AC2 ('pytest -m "not integration and not external" is green on main'): the subject failure IS gone, but the marker suite is NOT literally green at 9bdb22f5887. A full run here (10821 passed, 18 failed, 789s) shows zero coverage-reconstruction failures, and 17 of the 18 are environment artifacts of this venv (9x missing 'ddgs' optional dep; 3x+2x stale botocore 1.40.61 < 1.43.64; 1x stale ruff 0.15.19 vs the pinned 0.16.1; 1x test_check_criteria_vocabulary scanning a concurrent agent's .claude/worktrees/ tree). But ONE is a genuine repo-level failure reproducible standalone on a clean tree: tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py::test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail — AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'headers', because src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101 _request_token now reads request.headers while the test's fake request is a SimpleNamespace without one. Unrelated to this ticket; I will not assert 'green' while it fails. This ticket therefore stays open pending either that fix or an operator decision to narrow AC2 to the coverage-reconstruction cell.
